location.name: Level
location.label: w' == (inflow() - QMAX * u / (NSET - 1.0) * sqrt(fmax(w, 0.0) / MAXLVL) - CSPILL * pow(fmax(w - MAXLVL, 0.0), 1.5)) / AREA - (w > 0.0 ? EVAP : 0.0) && lvlInt' == w && dist' == MAXLVL - w && excess' == fmax(w - MAXLVL, 0.0) && deficit' == fmax(MINLVL - w, 0.0)

template.name: Controller
template.declaration: clock t; // time since last decision

query.formula: simulate [<=H] { w, MINLVL, MAXLVL, u * 0.5, rain * 0.5 }
query.comment: Random outlet choices (no strategy): level, limits, outlet setting and rain class (scaled).
Baseline (random outlet): expected average water level.

query.comment: Baseline (random outlet): probability of exceeding the maximum level.

query.formula: strategy Opt = minE (dist + PEN_OVER * excess + PEN_UNDER * deficit) [<=H] { rain } -> { w } : <> time >= H
query.comment: Learn a periodic controller: observes the rain class and the water level at each decision; minimises the integral of (max level - level) with heavy penalties for exceeding the max level and for dropping below the min level.
Save the learned strategy Opt to a file (run right after learning).
Reload Opt from file instead of re-learning (only valid if the model has not changed since it was saved).

query.formula: simulate [<=H] { w, MINLVL, MAXLVL, u * 0.5, rain * 0.5 } under Opt

query.comment: Learned controller: expected average water level.
Learned controller: probability of exceeding the maximum level (overflow).
